bugs.description: Selector .task-item is defined at line 974 (flex-direction: row; align-items: center;) and again at line 1071 (flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;). The second definition completely overrides the first, making lines 974-977 dead code.
bugs.impact: Task items may not render as intended. The row layout from line 974 is never applied.
bugs.recommendation: Merge both definitions or rename second one to .task-item-expanded with a modifier class.

bugs.description: Line 2776 uses 'overflow-y: auto !important' on .terminal-pane .xterm-viewport. This is a strong override signal that may hide legitimate xterm.js library overflow handling.
bugs.impact: Could cause maintenance issues if xterm library tries to manage overflow internally.
bugs.recommendation: Remove !important. If required, add comment explaining why it's necessary.

bugs.description: Selector .clear-btn is defined twice: lines 883-893 (background: var(--bg-tertiary); border: 1px solid var(--border-normal);) and lines 1157-1171 (background: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #333;). Second definition completely overrides the first.
bugs.impact: First definition is 100% dead code - never applied.
bugs.recommendation: Remove lines 883-893 entirely. This is clean-up work.

inconsistencies.description: Throughout the file, hard-coded hex values appear instead of using defined CSS variables from :root. This breaks theme consistency.
inconsistencies.impact: Theme changes require editing multiple locations instead of changing one variable. Maintenance burden increases.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Replace all hard-coded colors with var(--color-*) or var(--status-*) variables from line 10-95.

inconsistencies.description: Hardcoded pixel values (8px, 12px, 16px, 20px) mixed with CSS variables (--space-2=8px, --space-3=12px, etc.).
inconsistencies.impact: Inconsistent spacing makes layout harder to maintain. Changes to spacing scale require multiple edits.

inconsistencies.description: Hard-coded border-radius values (4px, 6px, 8px, 20px) instead of using --radius-* variables.
examples: Line 792: border-radius: 20px (no equivalent variable defined; creates semantic gap)
Line 939: border-radius: 8px (overlaps with --radius-md:10px; should match or define new variable)
inconsistencies.recommendation: Define missing radius variables (--radius-xs, --radius-tiny) and standardize usage.

inconsistencies.issue: Priority badge colors use direct hex instead of status variables
inconsistencies.description: Task priorities (.task-priority.priority-high: #f87171) don't reference var(--status-error), var(--status-warning), var(--status-success) even though these are defined.
inconsistencies.impact: Minor - colors happen to match but aren't semantically tied to the design system.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Replace with status variables for consistency.

dead_code.reason: Lines 974-977 define flex-direction: row; align-items: center;, but line 1071 redefines .task-item with flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;. The first definition is completely overridden.
dead_code.impact: Code clarity - reader sees conflicting definitions.
dead_code.recommendation: Remove lines 974-977 or merge into single .task-item rule.

dead_code.reason: Completely overridden by second definition at lines 1157-1171. All properties are redefined (background, border, color, font-size, cursor, transition).
dead_code.impact: Dead code takes up space. Confuses readers about which definition is active.

dead_code.reason: Display is set to 'none' with comment 'Disabled - using snap-point grid on desktop instead'. This pseudo-element is never rendered.
dead_code.impact: Zero - just adds clutter and comments.
dead_code.recommendation: Remove entire rule if truly unused. Keep only if it might be re-enabled.

dead_code.reason: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) is defined but never used in any animation throughout the 3600+ line file.
dead_code.impact: Unused variable clutters the design token space.
dead_code.recommendation: Search file for --ease-out-back usage; if truly unused, remove.

animation_and_performance.gpu_friendly: Most animations use transform and opacity - good for performance

concerns.issue: Uses background-position animation which causes repaints, not GPU-accelerated transforms
concerns.recommendation: Consider replacing with transform: skewX() or similar for better performance

concerns.issue: Animation borderFlow is applied with 'paused' state and only runs on hover (line 442)
concerns.recommendation: Consider if this adds value or just adds code complexity

vendor_prefixes.note: File appropriately uses -webkit- prefixes paired with standard properties for maximum browser compatibility

unused_variables.recommendation: Remove if not used by other files
